errors.text_span: с етикети на всеки две години
errors.evidence: The x-axis has labels for every year from 2006 to 2019, not every two years.
The line in the chart is solid, not dashed (пунктирен).

errors.text_span: и кръгче като маркер във всяка отбелязана точка
errors.evidence: The line in the chart has no markers.

errors.text_span: От 2010 до 2013 г. има постепенно увеличение до около 2,1%
errors.evidence: This is an over-simplification of the trend. The line rises, stays flat, rises to a peak of about 2.6% in 2012, and then falls to about 1.8% by 2013. It is not a gradual increase.
The value for 2014 is approximately 0.2%, not 0.8%.
The value for 2015 is the minimum on the chart, at approximately -0.5%, not -0.1%.
The value for 2019 is approximately 1.6%, not 1.1%.
The value for 2017 is closer to 1.4%, not 1.6%.
